entries.sourceReference: Chris Redfield in the standard BSAA outfit from Resident Evil 5 (2009). All simple-slot rows show physical M92F fire, including explicitly adapted crossover aerial shots and a ledge get-up shot only after releasing the edge. Ordinary secondary Straight and chargeRelease are short physical punches. Movement, guard and ledge Catch/Hang/Climb keep the M92F holstered. Dedicated32 Satellite Laser uses an external designator and is not the full45 secondary. Choreography is project adaptation, not source-game frame extraction.

normalization.method: Connected-alpha whole-pose segmentation; one body calibration, nearest-neighbor pixel scale and render factor per native source. Explicit real corrective rows inserted without synthesizing anatomy.
normalization.baselineDefinition: bottom-exclusive full-pose alpha bound; ledge attachment uses separately measured real gloved palms.
normalization.alphaCleanup: Exclude near-transparent background noise below24; original PNGs archived unchanged.

visualValidation.facing: Right by default apart from genuine KO/airborne anatomical projection.
visualValidation.outfit: RE5 standard Chris: short dark-brown hair, olive BSAA vest, light tan short-sleeve shirt, dark cargo trousers, boots, black fingerless gloves and thigh M92F holster.
visualValidation.weapons: One compact physical M92F pistol in attackLight1/2/3, crouchLight, aerialNeutral/Forward/Down and ledgeAttack after releasing the edge. Straight uses free fists. All movement/guard/Catch/Hang/Climb rows keep the pistol holstered and hands free. No rifle, rocket launcher, body beam or supernatural shield.
visualValidation.stature: 190px effective body calibration per native source; crouches, hanging arms and lowered projections keep their native proportions. Corrective source uses its own documented upright calibration.
limitations: Original generated adapted choreography, not official RE5 frames or certified pixel/timing reproduction.
Small anatomy/outfit details can vary between native drawings.
Ledge traversal and airborne M92F shots are explicit crossover gameplay adaptations; no canonical RE5 jump animation is claimed.
Runtime M92F simple-slot impact uses the existing profile range/timing resolver, without a physically tracked projectile. These visual-only assets add no projectile, hit or damage.
